learned_router_predecessor.status: independent trained research; not integrated or modified

eval.factual_outcomes: original P3 analytic_consequence(action,t=0 for old, t=40 for recent) computed by evaluator only after all predictions
eval.router_input: only last genuinely observed factual (action, consequence) pairs, never regime label, t or current outcome
eval.source_predictor: fixed step80 trained model + evaluator chosen copy of saved step40 or step80 native fast weights, recent recurrent/history
eval.arm_note: anti-action evidence uses same completed outcomes but deliberately swaps the sign of its paired factual action; negative control, not deployable
eval.late_window: events 4-15 of each 16-event block, after real factual observations; first four scored separately

limits: public analytic regime previously observed in P3 training
hand-coded P6 effect-sign selector; not P7 learned history encoder
causal context is inferred after prior factual outcomes, not zero-observation passive retrieval
no compute-matched trained controls and no independent held-out scientific success
stored old/new fast memories are evaluator-provided at design time and source-bound; no authentic durable encrypted memory archive
no active FORGE or Hybrid training controller and no accepted model change
